propositions: Startup must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY and validate the source (readable, regular file, Ed25519, no passphrase, 0600-or-stricter for path source) before queue/worker/network/workspace creation.
The process copies validated key material to a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, never modifies the deployment source, and observes replacements only after restart.

Both out-of-opcert_service producer chains (completion via sign_completion_verdict and plan-review via generation.sign_manifest) must accept an optional context-local OpcertSigner binding and sign from the injected binding when supplied by the service, while developer-local callers retain env/genesis defaults.

The op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency; the key is materialized externally by fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 file and bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH, and no REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM or key-retrieval region is set in the compose environment.
Concurrent and timed-out jobs must prove context-local isolation of signer, principal, and push policy with one immutable startup signer and no workspace push remote.
Secret and key material must not appear in repr, serialization, argv, logs, exceptions, output, fingerprints, provenance, children, or persisted envelopes beyond the existing public signature.
